mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_ID as noticeId, TITLE as title, CONTENT as content, CREATE_TIME as createTime, IS_ACTIVE as isActive FROM T_NOTICE ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT NOTICE_ID as noticeId, TITLE as title, CONTENT as content, CREATE_TIME as createTime, IS_ACTIVE as isActive FROM T_NOTICE WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT NOTICE_ID as noticeId, TITLE as title, CONTENT as content, CREATE_TIME as createTime, IS_ACTIVE as isActive FROM T_NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_NOTICE ( TITLE, CONTENT, CREATE_TIME, IS_ACTIVE ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{createTime}, #{isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CREATE_TIME = #{createTime}, IS_ACTIVE = #{isActive} WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
